fields.title: Spinal treatment
fields.bodyHtml:
Spinal treatment in Israel: advanced methods and approaches

Israel holds a leading position in the treatment of spinal disease and injury, offering patients access to the newest methods of diagnosis and therapy. Thanks to a comprehensive approach based on the latest research, Israeli clinics achieve outstanding results in restoring the function of the spine and improving patients' quality of life.

Spinal conditions treated in Israel:

  • Back pain associated with herniated discs
    Often caused by a disc bulging and pressing on the nerves.
  • Ankylosing spondylitis
    A chronic inflammatory condition affecting the spine and the sacroiliac joints.
  • Degenerative disc disease
    Degenerative changes in the intervertebral discs that reduce their elasticity and height.
  • Osteoporosis
    A condition in which the bones become fragile and porous, increasing the risk of fracture.
  • Spinal canal stenosis
    Narrowing of the canal that houses the spinal cord, which can cause pain and weakness.
  • Scoliosis
    Sideways curvature of the spine, often accompanied by rotation of the vertebrae.
  • Spinal fracture
    May result from injury, osteoporosis or other conditions.
  • Spinal deformity
    Covers various changes in the shape of the spine, such as scoliosis and kyphosis.
  • Herniated disc
    Protrusion of part of an intervertebral disc beyond its normal position, pressing on the nerve roots.

Methods of diagnosis

  1. MRI and CT
    Produce detailed images of the spine for accurate diagnosis.
  2. X-ray
    Used to assess the state of the bones of the spine.
  3. Electromyography (EMG)
    Assessment of the electrical activity of the muscles to identify nerve damage.
  4. Laboratory tests
    Help identify inflammation and other associated conditions.

Methods of treatment

  1. Conservative treatment
    Physiotherapy, medication and the use of braces.
  2. Minimally invasive operations
    Microdiscectomy and laser decompression.
  3. Surgery
    Spinal fusion and disc replacement.
  4. Comprehensive rehabilitation
    Includes physical exercises, manual therapy and psychological support.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  • A multidisciplinary approach
    Ensures a comprehensive treatment plan.
  • Advanced technology
    Guarantees accurate diagnosis and effective treatment.
  • An individual approach
    Takes account of every patient's particular needs.
  • Comprehensive support
    Provides full care at every stage of recovery.

Spinal treatment in Israel gives patients access to the most modern and effective therapies, helping them return to an active life free of pain.

fields.title: Blood cancer, also known as leukaemia
fields.bodyHtml:
Blood cancer: advanced treatment in Israel

Blood cancer, also known as haematological malignancy, covers a wide range of conditions including leukaemia, lymphoma and myeloma. Israel holds a leading position in diagnosing and treating blood cancer, offering patients access to innovative treatments and research aimed at improving prognosis and quality of life.

Diagnosis of blood cancer

  1. Full blood count
    Can reveal abnormal levels of white cells, red cells and platelets, which often indicate blood cancer.
  2. Bone marrow biopsy
    A key diagnostic method that allows the state of the bone marrow and the presence of cancer cells to be assessed.
    (histology brought from elsewhere can also be reviewed)
  3. Immunophenotyping
    Used to determine the types of cancer cells on the basis of their molecular and cellular markers.
  4. Molecular and genetic testing,
    including PCR and cytogenetic analysis, helps identify the genetic mutations and chromosomal abnormalities associated with different types of blood cancer.
  5. Imaging,
    such as CT, MRI and PET-CT, may be ordered to identify enlarged lymph nodes or other sites affected by the disease.

Methods of treating blood cancer

  1. Chemotherapy
    The main treatment for blood cancer, aimed at destroying the cancer cells.
  2. Targeted therapy
    Involves medicines directed at specific molecular targets in the cancer cells.
  3. Immunotherapy
    Stimulates the body's immune system to fight the cancer cells.
  4. Bone marrow (stem cell) transplantation
    A treatment in which the patient's damaged bone marrow is replaced with healthy marrow.
  5. Radiotherapy
    May be used for certain types of blood cancer, in particular to reduce the size of lymph nodes or affected areas.

Why patients choose Israel for the treatment of blood cancer

  • Highly qualified specialists and the use of advanced medical technology ensure a comprehensive and effective approach to treatment.
  • Individual treatment programmes are developed according to the type of blood cancer, the stage of the disease and the patient's particular circumstances.
  • Access to the newest treatments and clinical trials allows patients to receive innovative therapy, including experimental treatment.

fields.title: Leukaemia
fields.bodyHtml:
Leukaemia: advanced treatment in Israel

Leukaemia is a group of cancers of the blood and bone marrow marked by a raised level of white blood cells. In Israel, patients with leukaemia are offered a comprehensive approach to treatment that includes the latest research and individual treatment strategies.

Diagnosis of leukaemia

  1. Full blood count
    Can detect abnormal levels of white blood cells, anaemia and other changes.
  2. Bone marrow biopsy and aspiration
    The main methods of confirming a diagnosis of leukaemia, allowing the state of the bone marrow to be assessed.
    (histology brought from elsewhere can also be reviewed)
  3. Cytogenetic analysis
    Examination of the chromosomes of the cancer cells to identify genetic abnormalities.
  4. Immunophenotyping
    Testing to determine the type of leukaemia from the characteristics of the cancer cells.
  5. Molecular and genetic testing
    Identification of specific genetic mutations associated with different types of leukaemia.

Treatment of leukaemia

  1. Chemotherapy
    The main treatment, aimed at destroying the cancer cells.
  2. Targeted therapy
    The use of medicines directed at specific molecular targets in the cancer cells.
  3. Immunotherapy
  4. The use of monoclonal antibodies and other medicines to stimulate the immune system against the cancer cells.
  5. Haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (bone marrow transplant)
    Allows healthy bone marrow to be restored after intensive treatment.
  6. Radiotherapy
    Sometimes used to destroy cancer cells or in preparation for a stem cell transplant.
  7. CAR-T cell therapy
    A newer treatment in which the patient's T cells are modified to fight the cancer cells.

Why patients choose Israel

  • A multidisciplinary approach: the knowledge and experience of specialists from various fields of medicine are combined to develop the best treatment plan.
  • Advanced technology: access to the newest methods of diagnosis and treatment, including molecular and genetic testing and innovative therapies.
  • Individual treatment: treatment programmes developed with the genetic features of the disease and the patient's general condition in mind.
  • A high standard of medical care: modern medical institutions providing high-quality care and support at every stage of treatment.

Treatment of leukaemia in Israel gives patients access to advanced medical resources and innovative therapies, which helps achieve the best results against the disease.

fields.title: Hodgkin lymphoma
fields.bodyHtml:
Hodgkin lymphoma: advanced treatment in Israel

Hodgkin lymphoma is a type of lymphoma marked by the presence of particular cells known as Reed-Sternberg cells. In Israel, patients with Hodgkin lymphoma have access to modern methods of diagnosis and treatment based on the latest research and clinical experience.

Diagnosis of Hodgkin lymphoma

  1. Physical examination and history
    The initial assessment includes examination for enlarged lymph nodes and the gathering of information about symptoms.
  2. Laboratory tests
    Full blood count and measurement of the erythrocyte sedimentation rate.
  3. Lymph node biopsy
    Taking and examining a tissue sample to identify Reed-Sternberg cells.
    (histology brought from elsewhere can also be reviewed)
  4. Computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
    Assessment of how far the disease has spread in the body.
  5. PET-CT
    A combination of positron emission and computed tomography to identify active sites of disease.
  6. Bone marrow biopsy
    Examination for involvement of the bone marrow.

Treatment of Hodgkin lymphoma

  1. Chemotherapy
    The main treatment, often combined with targeted drugs.
  2. Radiotherapy
    Used for localised stages of the disease or after chemotherapy to destroy remaining tumour cells.
  3. Combined therapy
  4. A combination of chemotherapy and radiotherapy to achieve the greatest effect.
  5. Bone marrow transplantation
    Used in cases of relapse or refractory lymphoma.
  6. Immunotherapy
    The use of monoclonal antibodies directed at destroying the cancer cells.
  7. CAR-T cell therapy
    An innovative treatment in which the patient's T cells are modified in the laboratory so that they recognise and destroy cancer cells more effectively, and are then returned to the patient's body.

Why patients choose Israel

  • An individual approach
    Treatment is planned according to the stage of the disease, the patient's general health and their personal preferences.
  • Multidisciplinary teams
    Oncologists, haematologists, radiologists and other specialists work closely together to develop the most effective treatment plan.
  • Access to advanced technology
    The use of the latest advances in medicine and science, including the newest drugs and treatments.
  • A high standard of medical care
    A distinguishing feature of Israeli clinics is their attention to detail and their commitment to patients' comfort.

Treatment of Hodgkin lymphoma in Israel offers a comprehensive approach that combines the high qualifications of its specialists, an individual approach to every patient and the use of the most modern therapies, including CAR-T cell therapy, which gives a good chance of successful treatment and an improved quality of life.
